body:
I took, 4.5 grams at 5:30pm felt nothing within the first hour and half.
6:30 started feeling giggly, feeling slightly heavy, movement feels slightly delayed.
7:15 smoked some cannabis, started feeling weird, slightly paranoid my time perception is dissolving and confused.
8:00 complete disassociation from my body, saw something I wish have never seen. Something that is beyond my imagination.
9:00 I could not find my body at all, it was crazy I wish I could get into detail but it was too much for my mind at the time.
